user.title: Add an ONVIF camera
user.description: Enter the camera's address and its ONVIF login. On TP-Link VIGI cameras the ONVIF port is usually 2020; on most others it is 80.

data_description.name: Shown on the device and entities, e.g. Gate or Car Porch.
data_description.protocol: Use HTTPS only if the camera's ONVIF service is set to HTTPS.

stream.title: Video stream
stream.description: Pick the stream used for live view and snapshots. The main stream has the best quality; the sub stream is lighter on phones.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to {name} again
reauth_confirm.description: The camera rejected the saved login.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the camera's ONVIF service. Check the IP, port and protocol, and that ONVIF is enabled on the camera.
error.invalid_auth: The camera rejected the username or password.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This camera is already added (its address has been updated).

init.title: Camera settings
init.description: Choose what to change, then press Save.

data.event_off_delay: Keep event sensors on for at least

data_description.snapshot_keep: Older snapshot files are deleted. They are stored in /config/onvif_motion/.
data_description.event_off_delay: 0 = turn off as soon as the camera says the event ended.

telegram.title: Telegram
telegram.description: Pick the Telegram chat(s) from the Telegram bot already set up in Home Assistant, or enter a bot token and chat IDs. Alerts are sent with the snapshot attached. Leave everything empty to turn Telegram off.

data_description.telegram_bot_token: Only if you don't use the Home Assistant bot. From @BotFather, e.g. 123456:ABC-DEF…
data_description.telegram_chat_ids: One or more chat or group IDs, separated by commas.
data_description.telegram_notify_entities: Uses your existing Telegram bot integration; no token needed here.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: Pick how WhatsApp messages are sent. Cloud API sends the snapshot as a photo; CallMeBot sends text only.

data_description.whatsapp_recipients: With country code, separated by commas, e.g. +919876543210. Not needed for the notify action.
data_description.whatsapp_notify_action: Only for 'Home Assistant notify action', e.g. notify.whatsapp.

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: Change the camera's address, login or video stream. The camera is checked before saving and reconnects when you press Save.

data_description.password: Leave empty to keep the current password.
data_description.rtsp_transport: TCP is the most reliable. Try UDP for lower delay, or HTTP if the stream drops through a firewall.
data_description.stream_url: Optional. Leave empty to use the address the camera reports, e.g. rtsp://192.168.31.101:554/stream1. Login is added automatically.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the camera's ONVIF service. Check the IP, port and protocol, and that ONVIF is enabled on the camera.
error.invalid_auth: The camera rejected the username or password.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.
error.different_camera: A different camera answers at this address. Add it as a new camera instead.

take_snapshot.name: Take snapshot
take_snapshot.description: Save a snapshot now and make it the latest snapshot.

send_alert.name: Send alert
send_alert.description: Send a Telegram / WhatsApp alert, optionally with a fresh snapshot.

message.name: Message
message.description: Text to send. Leave empty for the default message.

attach_snapshot.name: Attach snapshot
attach_snapshot.description: Take a snapshot and attach it.
